notes: NOTES (src/NOTES.sol, contract NOTES) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on the vendored OpenZeppelin v5.0.2 ERC20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints INITIAL_SUPPLY, 1,000,000,000 NOTES (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units), once to msg.sender, which under ProjectFactory.launchCustom is the factory. There is no owner, no mint, burn, pause, blacklist, freeze or upgrade path, no transfer fee, rebase or exemption logic, and no external calls, so every launch flow (the swarm's share to the MerkleDistributor, the single-sided seed through the PoolManager, the remainder to economics.remainderTo, and trader swaps) moves exactly the amount requested. The launch deploys no application contracts and makes no initialization calls. The pool pairs NOTES with IMD at 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127 on Robinhood Chain at the launch policy's 1.25% fee with tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (2,500 IMD for the whole supply) and totalSupply.
